title: BudgetCommand
responsibility: Registers the harness budget measure, status, history, establish, approve and bench commands.

inputs.name: registerBudgetCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander Command instance on which the budget CLI is registered. It matters during setup because the implementation attaches the budget command and its child commands to it; a plain options object is not accepted.

outputs.name: registerBudgetCommand
outputs.description: Registration returns no value after attaching the budget command tree to the supplied program. Callers observe the setup through that mutated Commander instance, not through a returned result.
